urn:csabs:concept/StateBasedCRDT.definition: A join-semilattice state space with bottom and inflationary local updates, merged by join.
urn:csabs:concept/StateBasedCRDT.leanModelLimitations: Compiled carrier and selected interface interpretation. Some catalog operations are specified mathematically rather than wrapped as Lean declarations; no blanket proof of claims, algorithms, parsing, liveness or complexity. See individual witnesses.
urn:csabs:concept/StateBasedCRDT.mathematicalFormulation: For a join semilattice S with bottom, merge(s,t)=s⊔t and each update u_o:S→S satisfies s≤u_o(s). The structure imposes no commutativity on updates and no network delivery or liveness condition.
